scope: Uniform native task_status attempt-history interval estimate for all 64 owned GPU jobs. Includes all retained started attempts, initialization, idle intervals and teardown. Child work inside a holder is charged once. Native timestamps are not provider billing. Queue gaps are excluded from attempt sums. Submission envelopes are separate and include queueing.
history_api_correction: list_tasks contains current attempts only. task_status returns retained history, including preempted attempts. This recomputation supersedes prior partial observed-interval totals; never add both totals together.
